item.title: Youngstown State University announces first programs in Jefferson County
item.description: JEFFERSON COUNTY, OH (WTRF) - Youngstown State University Steubenville has officially announced its first slate of academic programs that will begin this fall. The associate degree programs, include criminal justice, nursing, social work, welding, business administration, and many others. They also will have certificate programs in police academy, welding, machining, and medical assisting.
